name: hidden-fees-budget
description: Shop leads with a parts-and-labor headline and reveals the shop-supply fee only when challenged. The hidden fee must still be extracted and evidenced.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant phoning on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Pads and rotors on a Camry? That runs $489.
Is that truly all-in? Please identify parts, labor, shop supplies, diagnostic, disposal, and tax separately.
That $489 was parts and labor — parts are $285 and labor is $204. Shop supplies are $45, diagnostic and disposal are $0, and tax is $40.
Thank you. Please confirm the final all-in total, warranty, earliest appointment, and how long the quote holds.
All-in it's $574. Warranty is 90 days, parts and labor. We can get you in Thursday morning, and the quote is good for 7 days.
Confirmed: $574 all-in with the 90-day warranty. I'll present that exact quote to the customer.
